text_block_list.text: While explaining the new training menu—

Sensing a slight movement from Mejiro Ramonu,
I looked up from my tablet.

She looks like the same Mejiro Ramonu as usual...
And yet, something felt strangely off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Please proceed with that training menu.
I felt a strange roughness in Mejiro Ramonu's usually fluid and elegant demeanor. It was exceedingly subtle, but present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: Could it be... you're feeling unwell?
Could it be... you're feeling unwell?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I have a slight headache.
Though it's mild enough to manage.

Mejiro Ramonu seems to have a migraine.
She will likely be troubled by the pain for a while.
